archetypes.name: dyn-transcript-capture
archetypes.rationale: Transcript capture spans token lookup plus design, implement, and review callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed Claude transcript source plumbing. Focus on whether larch run IDs can still leak into transcript lookup, whether requested Claude session IDs fail closed, and whether cached snapshots remain reusable only when they point at a real transcript. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
